description: Covers company registration and active status in selected registers, US consumer-finance complaints, and public filings. Search by legal name or US ticker and optionally compare a second company. Customer reviews, stock prices and scam reports aren't included.

company.description: Company name or US stock ticker, e.g. 'Capital One', 'Chime', 'NVDA'

compare_to.description: Second company or US ticker in the same country

country.description: Country where the company is registered or operates; leave out for the US

months.description: How far back to count; default 24

name: check_company
title: Company: registration, filings, complaints
